crossRefs.note: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

people.name: Eder
people.line: Levite descendant of Merari during David's reign

people.name: Jerimoth
people.line: A Levite, son of Mushi, from the Merari clan.

people.name: Mahli
people.line: Son of Mushi, grandson of Merari.

people.name: Mushi
people.line: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.

translations.web: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
translations.bsb: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth —three in all.
translations.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
translations.asv: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
